 This week's festival ticket sales: Alejandro Sanz on Tuesday, Benidorm Fest from 24 to 26, the Sonorama line-up and Pecos's farewell
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Pau 
 21 Nov 2026, 14:00 
 A 4-minute read 
 B.jars / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 On Tuesday 24 at 10:00 tickets go on sale for Alejandro Sanz's twelve dates , six of them at festivals, and at 12:00 for the first Benidorm Fest semi-final and Los Secretos at 1001 Músicas. 
 On Wednesday 25 Sonorama Ribera unveils its full line-up in Madrid , but general sale of passes does not open until Tuesday 1 December; the second Benidorm Fest semi-final also goes on sale that day. 
 On Thursday 26 tickets for the Benidorm Fest final go on sale , at €75 plus fees, with the album of the eighteen songs included. 
 On Friday 27 at 12:00 Pecos's farewell tour goes on sale , with four summer festivals; for now, the big festivals have not announced any Black Friday discounts. 
 In the last week of November, sales are concentrated on Tuesday: at 10:00 Alejandro Sanz 's Spanish tour goes on sale, with six festival dates, and two hours later the staggered sale for Benidorm Fest begins. The rest of the week brings the line-ups of Sonorama Ribera and Arenal Sound and the farewell tour of Pecos . This is the calendar from Monday 23 to Sunday 29 November, with times as published on Saturday 21.
 Festival guide 
 Concert Music Festival 2027 
 Dates to be confirmed · Poblado de Sancti Petri, Chiclana de la Frontera 
 Tickets 
 Disponibles 
 Tuesday 24: Alejandro Sanz, the first Benidorm Fest semi-final and Los Secretos
 At 10:00 tickets go on sale for the twelve concerts of Alejandro Sanz 's “¿Y ahora qué +?” tour, with the artist's website as the starting point. Six are at festivals, and each one sells through its own channel:
 Concert Music Festival , Chiclana, Saturday 31 July at 22:30: on Ticketmaster , which already has the page up with a countdown. ModoFestival may receive a commission if you buy through this link, at no extra cost to you.
 Córdoba Live , Thursday 15 July: at El Corte Inglés, from €88.
 Icónica Sevilla Fest , Saturday 19 June: from the festival's website, which for now says “tickets coming soon”.
 Marenostrum Fuengirola , Saturday 10 July: on the festival's website.
 Poniente Live , Benidorm, Friday 23 July: on Entradas.com and El Corte Inglés, according to Benidorm City Council.
 Doñana Music Experience , Matalascañas, Thursday 29 July: from the artist's website.
 The dates, the rest of the tour and what is known about each festival are in our article on Alejandro Sanz at the 2027 festivals .
 At 12:00 sales open for the first semi-final of Benidorm Fest 2027 , on Tuesday 26 January at the Palau d'Esports L'Illa, at €40 plus fees on Vivaticket. Each gala goes on sale on a different day, as we explain in our Benidorm Fest 2027 ticket guide .
 Also at 12:00 , according to their tour website, tickets go on sale for Los Secretos at 1001 Músicas , in Granada, on Thursday 9 September 2027, one of the stops on the 33 dates of “Nada es como antes” .
 Wednesday 25: Sonorama and Arenal Sound line-ups, and the second semi-final
 Sonorama Ribera unveils the full line-up for its 30th anniversary edition, from 4 to 8 August 2027 in Aranda de Duero, at a party at Sala El Sol in Madrid at 20:30 , with entry at €10 including a drink, as we reported in our article on the presentation . Sales do not change that day: the first tier of passes, at €85, is sold out, and general sale begins on Tuesday 1 December , with no time published.
 Arenal Sound also has a line-up preview on the 25th, with no time announced, for its edition from 29 July to 1 August 2027 in Burriana. Passes are still on sale in its shop, from €65. What has already been confirmed is in our article on the first names for Arenal Sound 2027 .
 At 12:00 the second Benidorm Fest semi-final goes on sale, on Thursday 28 January, also at €40 plus fees.
 Thursday 26: the Benidorm Fest final
 The staggered sale ends at 12:00 with the final on Saturday 30 January, at €75 plus fees . Each ticket includes the CD with the contest's eighteen songs. No official source has published the ticket limit per person.
 Friday 27: Pecos's farewell tour and Black Friday
 Pecos put the twenty dates of their farewell tour, “Concierto para una despedida”, on sale at 12:00 . Four are at summer festivals: Stone & Music , at the Teatro Romano de Mérida, on Sunday 6 June; Córdoba Live, on Saturday 19 June; Marenostrum Fuengirola, on Saturday 7 August; and Poniente Live, in Benidorm, on Tuesday 10 August. The full tour is in our article on Pecos's farewell .
 Friday 27 is also Black Friday. As of Saturday 21, none of the big festivals we checked, such as Mad Cool, Resurrection Fest, Medusa, Low, FIB or Viña Rock, had announced discounts for that day.
 What to keep an eye on
 The Viña Rock 2027 pass costs from €34.99 “until Sunday or while stocks last”, without specifying which Sunday, so the price may change this very week. Cooltural Fest sold out its blind passes, and the Almería press expects its first names in the coming days, with no date or price for a new tier.
 Sources: official announcement of Alejandro Sanz's tour, Ticketmaster, El Corte Inglés, Benidorm City Council and the Icónica and Marenostrum websites; RTVE via Eurovision-Spain and Diario de Alicante (Benidorm Fest); official websites of Los Secretos, Sonorama Ribera, Arenal Sound, Pecos, Viña Rock and Cooltural Fest, consulted on 21 November 2026.
